reasoning: I applied the deletion test to the package entry point rather than treating re-export syntax itself as evidence of a middle-man. Deleting packages/io/src/index.ts would not make complexity vanish: the package has no exported subpaths, so imports currently spread across server production and test files would need to be rewritten and package.json would need multiple new entry points; moreover, the root joins a real two-adapter seam, with ArtNetOutput and SacnOutput both implementing PixelOutput. The blanket surface may independently merit API curation, but that is not evidence that the package boundary is a deletion-test middle-man, and the proposed fix itself retains that boundary as another barrel.
